indicators.label: Total population
indicators.description: Census of India 2011 C-01 total persons in the reporting district.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of total persons counted in the seven named or other religious-affiliation categories.
indicators.method: 100 * (Hindu + Muslim + Christian + Sikh + Buddhist + Jain + Other religions and persuasions) / C-01 Total persons.
indicators.quality_notes: Religion not stated is excluded from the numerator and is not interpreted as no religion.

indicators.quality_notes: Rows carry no_religion_category_absent and null no_religion_count/no_religion_percent values.
